wheel.en: How were these enormous statues moved across the island without wheels, tools, or animals?
wheel.zh: 在没有轮子、工具或动物的情况下，这些巨大的石像是如何在岛上被运送的呢？

wheel.en: Medvedev gets into the car, then says “But where is the steering wheel?”
wheel.zh: 梅德韦杰夫上车后说：“但是方向盘在哪里呢？”

wheel.en: New engines, new wheels, new paint, but they still call it the same car… is it?
wheel.zh: 新引擎、新车轮、新油漆，但他们仍然叫它同一辆车……是这样吗？

wheel.en: The Incas didn’t have iron tools or wheeled transport, but they still created these incredible cities.
wheel.zh: 印加人没有铁器工具或轮式运输工具，但他们仍然创造了这些不可思议的城市。

wheel.en: You're never going to talk to him. You're just a cog in the wheel there.
wheel.zh: 你永远都不会跟他说话。你在那儿只是个微不足道的齿轮。

whereas.en: Whereas if you are a shark, you will eventually find yourself swimming entirely amongst sharks.
whereas.zh: 而如果你是一条鲨鱼，你最终会发现自己完全在鲨鱼群中游弋。

whereas.en: Whereas, well, you always have this sort of sense, and this is what leaderboards are, right?
whereas.zh: 然而，财富，你总是有一种这样的感觉，这就是排行榜的意义所在，对吧？

whereas.en: Right. Whereas before it's like, okay, I have to, I have to sleep on it.
whereas.zh: 对吧。然而以前的情况是，好吧，我得，我得考虑一晚。

whereas.en: Yeah. Whereas, I don't know about you, but I didn't have that modeled in my house.
whereas.zh: 是的。然而，我不知道你怎么样，但我家里没有这种示范。

whereas.en: Whereas what I used to do was I would jump in immediately.
whereas.zh: 而我过去常做的是我会立即跳进去。

whole.en: So in this whole process, what's the first time someone looked at your finances?
whole.zh: 所以在整个购房过程中，历史上第一次有人真正审查你的财务状况是什么时候？

whole.en: All of that might be true. But it is far from the whole story.
whole.zh: 所有这些也许都是真的。但这远非事情的全貌。

whole.en: And my friend got diagnosed first, told me about it, changed his whole life.
whole.zh: 你是什么时候发现自己有ADHD的？我两年前被诊断出来的。

whole.en: Toppling Mubarak was one thing; figuring out what came next was a whole different beast.
whole.zh: 推翻 Mubarak 是一回事；弄清楚接下来该怎么做完全是另一码事。

whole.en: The whole thing is over before most Comorians have understood what has happened.
whole.zh: 在大多数科摩罗人还没明白发生了什么之前，整件事就已经结束了。

whale.en: So, for a while, you're trying to harvest whales more and more effectively.
whale.zh: 所以，有一段时间，你一直在想办法更高效地捕鲸。

whale.en: You did. Unfortunately, the answer is actually the vaquita whale, which is about 1.5m long.
whale.zh: 没错。不过很遗憾，正确答案其实是小头鼠海豚，体长约 1.5 米。

whale.en: And they were very good at media. Joe gives a shout-out to Greenpeace activists for protecting whales.
whale.zh: 而且他们非常擅长运用媒体。Joe 为保护鲸鱼的绿色和平行动者们点赞(shout-out)。

whale.en: Fish, octopus, squid, sharks, whales, creatures of all shapes and sizes.
whale.zh: 鱼类、章鱼、乌贼、鲨鱼、鲸鱼，各种形状和大小的生物。

whale.en: They hunted seals and whales and caribou.
whale.zh: 他们猎捕海豹、鲸鱼和驯鹿。

whatever.en: Whatever happens to him next, that is, by any standard, a pretty remarkable run.
whatever.zh: 无论他接下来遭遇什么，按任何标准来看，这都是一段相当了不起的历程。

whatever.en: Nobody would see justice, at least publicly, for whatever happened to Otto Warmbier.
whatever.zh: 无论奥托·瓦姆比尔身上到底发生过什么，至少在公开层面上，没有人会为此讨回公道了。

whatever.en: And whatever you make of him, the story of JD Vance is still being written.
whatever.zh: 无论你对他作何评价，JD Vance 的故事仍在继续书写之中。

whatever.en: Not the spectacular one-time private jet with the friends to go for the whatever, whatever.
whatever.zh: 不是那种和朋友坐私人飞机去某地参加什么活动的壮观时刻。

whatever.en: Not the spectacular one-time private jet with the friends to go for the whatever, whatever.
whatever.zh: 不是那种和朋友坐私人飞机去某地参加什么活动的壮观时刻。

whisper.en: Now Neil, you asked me a question about a very quiet sound – a whisper.
whisper.zh: 现在Neil，你问了我一个关于非常安静的声音——耳语的问题。

whisper.en: I asked you how loud a whisper is. Yes, and I said 13 decibels.
whisper.zh: 我问你耳语有多大声。是的，我说的是13分贝。

whisper.en: In Salem Village, the devil wasn’t just a story whispered to scare children; he was real.
whisper.zh: 在塞勒姆村，魔鬼可不仅仅是用来吓唬小孩子的睡前故事；他是真实存在的。

whisper.en: Whispers began to spread. Would he march on Rome itself?
whisper.zh: 流言四起。他会直接进攻罗马城吗？

whisper.en: They flick through the pages, whispering to each other.
whisper.zh: 他们翻着护照的页面，彼此低声交谈。

whilst.en: So, whilst hearing is going, the brain tends to increase its listening effort, and so often it's a very slow process for you to realise that you're struggling with hearing.
whilst.zh: 所以，当听力逐渐丧失时，大脑往往会增加其倾听的努力，因此你往往要经过一个非常缓慢的过程才会意识到自己的听力出了问题。

whilst.en: Mixed opinions, it seems there Becca! Whilst one chocolate lover would pay more for chocolate to support farmers and production, the other doesn't worry too much about the cost, but says the production process should be as efficient as possible.
whilst.zh: 看来大家的意见不一，Becca！虽然一位巧克力爱好者愿意为巧克力支付更多费用以支持农民和生产，但另一位并不太担心成本，而是认为生产过程应该尽可能高效。

whilst.en: That's what I enjoyed about it. So I think that being where your feet are underneath you and allowing yourself to open up and stringing those together largely allows you to enjoy being whilst you're in the process of becoming.
whilst.zh: 这就是我享受它的原因。所以我认为，双脚着地，允许自己敞开心扉并把这些瞬间串联起来，很大程度上能让你在追求目标的过程中享受当下的存在。

whisky.en: For example, whisky is Scotland's signature drink.
whisky.zh: 例如，威士忌是苏格兰的招牌饮料。

wherever.en: Wherever you go, there’s going to be great English schools and also terrible English schools.
wherever.zh: 无论你去哪里，都会有很棒的英语学校，也会有糟糕的英语学校。

wherever.en: I get to interact with whoever I want, whenever I want, wherever I want.
wherever.zh: 我可以随时、随地、与任何我想见的人互动。

wherever.en: They want to just be blissfully happy wherever they are, whenever they are.
wherever.zh: 他们只想无论身在何处，无论何时，都感到极乐般的快乐。

wherever.en: I could get picked up, and if I went off wherever I went, it could happen.
wherever.zh: 我可能会被选中，如果我去了我去的任何地方，事情可能会发生。

wherever.en: So, does flourishing depend on your nationality, or are there things anyone can do to feel happier wherever they live?
wherever.zh: 那么，蓬勃发展取决于你的国籍，还是无论住在哪里，每个人都可以做些事情来让自己感到更幸福？

wheat.en: It is one of the world’s largest exporters of wheat, potash, and uranium.
wheat.zh: 它是世界最大的小麦、钾肥和铀出口国之一。

wheat.en: Most societies had a grain, wheat or rice or maize, but in Peru, they did not have some kind of basic grain.
wheat.zh: 大多数社会都有一种谷物，小麦、大米或玉米，但在秘鲁，他们没有某种基础谷物。

wheat.en: A king who knew the price of wheat, who went to bed at a reasonable hour, who had not been caught in any scandalous affairs.
wheat.zh: 一个知道小麦价格、按时上床睡觉、没有卷入任何桃色绯闻的国王。

wheat.en: Mmm, they're so good! Well, some people buy them dried in a packet, others make them fresh from wheat or rice, but there is little doubt that noodles are popular around the world.
wheat.zh: 嗯，它们太好吃了！有的人买包装好的干面，有的人用小麦或大米现做，毫无疑问，面条在世界各地都非常受欢迎。

wheat.en: Here's Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service programme The Food Chain: Cast your eye over most aisles in the supermarkets now and you'll see high protein products in abundance: pasta made with lentils and chickpeas rather than wheat flour, bread fortified with beans and pulses.
wheat.zh: 这位是来自BBC世界频道节目The Food Chain的主持人Ruth Alexander：现在随便扫一眼超市里的绝大多数货架，你就会发现大量的高蛋白产品：用扁豆和鹰嘴豆而不是小麦粉制作的意大利面，添加了豆类植物的面包。

whisker.en: The song lists all her favourite things, from 'raindrops on roses' to 'whiskers on kittens'.
whisker.zh: 这首歌列出了她所有最喜欢的事物，从“玫瑰上的雨滴”到“小猫的胡须”。

whenever.en: But maybe you avoid speaking whenever possible because you are afraid of making mistakes.
whenever.zh: 但只要有可能，你可能就会避免开口说话，因为你害怕犯错。

whenever.en: Third, using a language in real life situations whenever possible is really useful.
whenever.zh: 第三，尽可能在现实生活中使用一门语言真的很有用。

whenever.en: Whenever something needed to be done in Africa, Foccart knew who to call.
whenever.zh: 每当在非洲需要办什么事时，Jacques Foccart 都知道该找谁。

whenever.en: They use English all the time. The unconfident learner avoids speaking whenever possible.
whenever.zh: 他们无时无刻不在使用英语。不自信的学习者只要有机会就会避免开口。

whenever.en: I get to interact with whoever I want, whenever I want, wherever I want.
whenever.zh: 我可以随时、随地、与任何我想见的人互动。

whereby.en: There was a general trend whereby people in countries ranked higher on these “caregiving” scores reported having higher levels of happiness.
whereby.zh: 总体趋势是，在这些“关怀指数”上排名更高的国家的人们报告拥有更高水平的幸福感。

whereby.en: This was later expanded to even include the working poor, whereby parishes topped up the wages of underpaid workers to ensure that they had enough money to support their families.
whereby.zh: 后来，这一范围甚至扩大到了贫穷的工人阶级，教区以此来补贴薪水过低的工人，以确保他们有足够的钱养家糊口。

whistle.en: But if you manage it, if you master it, you'll be able to produce something that sounds like a chicken arguing through a child's toy whistle.
whistle.zh: 但如果你成功了，如果你掌握了它，你就能发出一种听起来像是一只鸡通过儿童玩具哨子在吵架的声音。

whoever.en: I get to interact with whoever I want, whenever I want, wherever I want.
whoever.zh: 我可以随时、随地、与任何我想见的人互动。

whoever.en: He fought for whoever was paying, as long as the politics broadly aligned with French interests.
whoever.zh: 只要政治方向大致符合法国的利益，谁给钱他就替谁卖命。

whoever.en: Whoever can bring them back cost effectively will become spectacularly wealthy.
whoever.zh: 谁能把它们划算地带回来，谁就会变得富可敌国。

whoever.en: And I think about that man, whoever I want him to be.
whoever.zh: 我一直在思考那个男人，无论我想成为什么样的男人。

whoever.en: And then whoever was a caretaker doesn't want to admit to the problem or didn't recognize the problem.
whoever.zh: 然后看护人不想承认问题，或者根本没意识到问题所在。

wholly.en: To those who had thought the deep sea was inhospitable, unable to sustain life, they were proved to be wholly mistaken.
wholly.zh: 对于那些曾认为深海不适宜居住、无法维持生命的人来说，事实证明他们完全错了。

wholly.en: His assassins were Islamists who did not agree with Egypt’s increasingly close relationship with Israel and held President Sadat wholly responsible.
wholly.zh: 刺杀他的是伊斯兰主义者，他们不同意埃及与以色列日益紧密的亲密关系，并将 Sadat 总统视为全部责任人。

whichever.en: Words pop up from whichever language comes fastest, and switching happens automatically.
whichever.zh: 词汇会从最快浮现的语言中蹦出来，而转换则是自动发生的。

whichever.en: Whichever ones win, the other side just surrenders because it's over.
whichever.zh: 哪一方赢了，另一方就投降，因为一切都结束了。

whichever.en: The benefits of societal distribution of the safer GLP-1s is so large that whichever politicians tackles that is going to be richly rewarded.
whichever.zh: 社会化分发更安全的GLP-1类药物所带来的益处是巨大的，任何解决这个问题的政客都将获得丰厚的回报。

whichever.en: Instead of searching for the correct word in one language, many bilinguals just pick the quickest or clearest option from whichever language fits their idea.
whichever.zh: 许多双语者不会费力去寻找某种语言中的正确词汇，而是直接从最符合他们想法的语言中挑选最快或最清晰的选项。

whip.en: Whips communicate between leaders and members trying to keep everyone in agreement.
whip.zh: 党鞭在领导层和成员之间进行沟通，试图让每个人达成一致。

whip.en: A Whip is a political party official whose job is to make sure members vote according to party lines.
whip.zh: “党鞭”（Whip）是一个政党官员，其职责是确保党内成员按照党派路线投票。

whitewash.en: You know what? I'll just say it. I'll whitewash the names.
whitewash.zh: 你知道吗？我就直说吧。我把名字隐去。
